qs.q: What microscopic feature surrounds the fluid-filled cleft-like cavities and damaged gray and white matter in cases of syringomyelia?
qs.e: Syringomyelia lesions show destruction of adjacent gray and white matter surrounded by dense reactive gliosis. Hydromyelia cavities are lined by ependyma.
